title: T1584.007 — Compromise Infrastructure - Serverless
subtitle: Watch how stolen cloud keys become a live command-and-control relay in minutes, and what the SOC notices at the same time.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker with stolen cloud keys deploys a serverless function, an infected workstation beacons through it to the attacker backend, and a SOC blocks the abuse and rotates the keys. A written step-by-step version follows below.
